resolution.note: dev replay v2/dev-k1 (16 run1 K losses, K 7b34dc7): model-visible hook messages per K session = 1 (16/16, the SessionStart context). The '10.1 vs 1.1' premise was a measurement artifact: replay.sh counted silent hook_success records and every session sharing the project directory; evals/d23/transcript.ts now counts per session (hook_events vs hook_msgs). run1 K (27fe971) also had 1 per session.

title: The K worker sees only scope prohibitions and task facts, not lead rules or positive directives
body:
Why: injected context files are neutral on hidden-test correctness and cost +19-23% (arxiv 2602.11988, Khatri 2607.27250); positive process directives cost 11-14 pp each while scope prohibitions help (2604.11088); n100 K runs carry 10.1 hook messages vs 1.1 for P and abandon more (7 vs 2). Evidence: .krn/runs/d23-comparison/research-2.md (main checkout).
Outcome: the worker tree laid by evals/d23/harness.ts HARNESS_ROOTS and the worker brief drop lead and governance rules (tracker, CI gate, handoff, lead context rules) and positive directives; scope prohibitions stay; informational hooks are silent in worker sessions.
Proof: a test lists the worker-visible rule lines and fails if a lead-only rule appears; D23 dev units replay shows hook messages per K run at or below 2.
Scope: evals/d23/, src/brain/, scripts/claude/, test/.
